summary: A decoupled event as an asset: anyone raises it, any number of listeners react, neither knows the other.
overview: An event that lives as an asset. Any script calls Raise() on it; any number of GameEventListener components react. The raiser never holds a reference to the listeners and vice versa. Create one asset per distinct event and drag it into both sides.
useCases: "Player died" or "level complete" broadcast to UI, audio and analytics at once.
Letting a designer wire a reaction in the Inspector with no code.
Breaking a hard reference between two systems that should not know about each other.

gotchas.title: Listeners are runtime registrations, not saved in the asset
gotchas.body: The asset is the channel, not the subscriber list. Who is listening depends entirely on what is enabled in the scene.

gotchas.title: Raise order is registration order, and not something to rely on
gotchas.body: If two listeners must happen in sequence, make that explicit rather than depending on which enabled first.
